from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader
from griffe.diff import get_diff

loader = GriffeLoader()
old = loader.load_from_git("mypkg", "v1.0.0")
new = loader.load_from_git("mypkg", "HEAD")

diff = get_diff(old, new)
for breakage in diff.breakages:
    print(breakage)
